caption: The drawing features a circular geometric pattern set against a light beige background with wavy bands of a slightly darker beige and several visible crack lines running through the image. The central circle contains symmetrical arrangements of objects, including several small greenish-blue circles, red elongated diamond shapes, and small red four-sided shapes, which are distributed radially. Around the edge of the circle, there are eight leaf- or fan-shaped sections filled with a muted green color and tan at the base, each outlined with spiked edges. Additional small greenish-blue rectangles and triangles fill the spaces between the central objects and the perimeter leaf shapes. The overall color palette includes subdued greens, reds, tan, and beige tones, with all forms arranged symmetrically within the circle, which is itself centered on the rectangular paper.
title: Detail of Stencilled Wall
